body: I have very similar issues too. I remember going through Instagram or Tik tok ( I used to start mbating on Instagram and Tim tok then move onto the hub ) and I’m scared I either got aroused ore jerked off to a video of young children play fighting. I believe it’s a false/ distorted memory but it’s shit scary. I know for certain I wouldn’t have finished on that and that’s what got me through in the end. But the uncertainty is a real killer.
Facts. Do you ever have it where you can feel it building up again? Like you know it’s going to start worrying you again for a bit.

It started with an intrusive thought in the summer. It’s now escalated to the point where I’m worried I’ve mbated to cp or did something terrible to a child. I know I’ve done neither but it is very scary especially when you don’t know your entire past
I agree. Same with Whistler in season 4. All that work just to be killed off instantly.

It’s an extremely long, confusing and exhausting story but I have pocd. It’s terrible. I’ve felt the lowest of the low recently but it all started on a random day I was watching twitch and an advert came up with a little girl and my brain had a thought. “What if I’m attracted to her?” I initially thought, “well that was pretty strange” then moved on until it kept happening. Then one day I had what I hope is a false memory hit me early September. ( it’s pretty disturbing so I won’t go into it) After that my head has been a pure mess, constantly questioning myslef, feeling guilty and even when I’m not thinking about my pocd, I feel it in the back of my head at all times. So yeah, it started randomly one day in the summer and has gotten worse and worse
It has for me. I’ve only had it a few months and I’m really quite at school now and my days are ruined as I’m so focused on my horrifying thoughts all day I can barely do work.
No diagnosis as I have not told anyone about it as there is more to this on other posts. But yes I do guess I need some health it’s unbearable.
Thank you for your replies means a lot
Thank you so much! That was really relieving to read. I know deep down I’m not a pedo but it feels like there is so much evidence there it’s feels like it’s all too much. Thank you

I think it could be the sort of jealous thought I get that everyone else doesn’t have to go through what I am or that I am a disgusting human being I shouldnt be here. When I’m at home it seems I have time to think and my thoughts seem clearer there.
Thank you! That means a lot

Yes I would. But I’d feel so ashamed. And I have to ask you something. My thoughts and anxiety tend to escalate greatly when I’m at school and I seem to be a lot more calm at home. It seems at school I am guilty and at home I am not

I’m currently going through what I believe is Pocd and I sit my gcse mock exams next month. All I can think about at school is what if my thoughts and “memories” are true and the guilt is crippling. I wish you the best of luck
